title: smime-tree: encrypt() has no security warning about RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 weakness
description: encrypt() uses Pkcs1v15Encrypt for RSA key transport. Neither the encrypt() doc nor lib.rs Known Limitations section warns that PKCS#1 v1.5 key transport is deprecated by RFC 8017 in favor of OAEP, or that it is vulnerable to Bleichenbacher padding oracle attacks. Add a # Security section to encrypt() and a bullet in the Known Limitations of lib.rs.
